name: Sun Cleric: Swift Justice already grants flat spell and melee/ranged haste (#1563)
contract: Both ranks carry effect 0 = APPLY_AURA SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS (aura 216) with MiscValue 0, and effect 1 = APPLY_AURA SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE (aura 192); both are generic, unconditional self-buffs with no EffectSpellClassMask (family filter 0, which SpellInfo::IsAffected treats as unrestricted -- 'if (!familyName) return true;'), so no per-ability routing is needed at all. Rank 1's BasePoints 2 resolves to 3 (DieSides 1), matching 'Increases your haste by 3%'; rank 2's BasePoints 5 resolves to 6, matching 'Increases your haste by 6%'. Both aura types are stock WotLK auras already handled generically by the engine. Native only, no server code needed.

steps.label: No haste aura before the talent
Rank 2 replaces rank 1: Increases your haste by 6%
